case.summary: A change that breaks a JSON document is rejected.
With validate warn a breaking change applies and is reported.
A write of a broken TOML document is rejected.
A write of a broken YAML document is rejected.
With validate off any text is written.
Removing many files reports a mass deletion.
A change of many targets is reported as a bulk operation.
Removing a non-empty directory reports a tree deletion.
Moving onto an existing file reports the overwrite.
Emptying a file reports it.
Shrinking a file by more than half reports it.
Many replacements in one file are reported.
A change without targets reports it and creates no operation.
A change of a CRLF file reports the preserved line endings.
A conversion of line endings is reported.
Changing a binary file is reported.
A preview of write reports the planned effect and changes nothing.
A preview of replace reports the planned effect and changes nothing.
A preview of remove reports the planned effect and changes nothing.
A preview of move reports the planned effect and changes nothing.
A preview of create reports the planned effect and changes nothing.
A preview of edit reports the planned effect and changes nothing.
A preview of set reports the planned effect and changes nothing.
A preview of convert reports the planned effect and changes nothing.
The report of a replacement counts files, replacements and lines.
The report of a replacement carries the difference.
